About us / Disclaimer:
Police watch provides a unique perspective into law enforcement, offering an unfiltered view of what officers face on the job. We feature footage captured by body-worn cameras worn by police officers, providing viewers with an unprecedented look into the daily experiences of law enforcement. From routine traffic stops to high-speed pursuits, police watch provides a rare opportunity to witness law enforcement in action, including the moments of tension and danger that officers face on a regular basis. 

In addition to providing an inside look into law enforcement, we aim to foster greater understanding and transparency between law enforcement and the communities they serve. By showing the public what officers encounter on a daily basis.

Whether you're interested in law enforcement or simply want to gain a deeper understanding of the challenges facing our communities, Police Watch provides valuable resource for anyone seeking an unfiltered look into the world of law enforcement.
